items.text: UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Tshono ebantwaneni bakoIsrayeli uthi kibo: Ngemikhosi yeNkosi elizayimemezela njengemihlangano engcwele, le iyimikhosi yami.
Izinsuku eziyisithupha kosetshenzwa, kepha usuku lwesikhombisa luyisabatha lokuphumula, umbuthano ongcwele; ningenzi msebenzi ngalo; kuyisabatha leNkosi ezindlini zenu zonke.
Lena imikhosi kaJehova, imibuthano engcwele, eniyakuyimemezela ngesikhathi esifanele.
Ngosuku lweshumi nane lwenyanga yokuqala kusihlwa kuyiphasika likaJehova.
Ngosuku lweshumi nanhlanu lwaleyo nyanga kungumkhosi wesinkwa esingenamvubelo wenkazimulo kaJehova; izinsuku eziyisikhombisa uyakudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo.
Ngosuku lokuqala kuyakuba khona umbuthano ongcwele kini; akukho msebenzi wenkonzo ongenziwa kuwo.
Kepha izinsuku eziyisikhombisa niyakunikela ngomnikelo womlilo kuJehova; ngosuku lwesikhombisa kuyakuba ngumhlangano ongcwele; ningasebenzi msebenzi kuyo.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Tshono ebantwaneni bakoIsrayeli uthi kibo: Nxa lingena elizweni engilinika lona, livune isivuno salo, lizaletha kumpristi isithungu solibo lwesivuno senu.
Kumelwe ahambise isithungu phambi kukaJehova ukuze samukelwe kini; ekuseni emva kwesabatha umpristi uyakuyisusa.
Ngosuku osusa ngalo isithungu, uyakulungisa iwundlu elinomnyaka munye elingenasici, libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuJehova.

Umnikelo wakhe wokudla uyakuba ngokweshumi okubili kwempuphu ecolekileyo exovwe namafutha, umnikelo womlilo kuJehova, ube yiphunga elimnandi; umnikelo wakhe wokuphuzwayo uyakuba yiwayini, okwesine kwehini.

Aniyikudla isinkwa, nokolweni okugazingiwe, noma amabele aluhlaza, kuze kufike lolo suku eninikela ngalo ngomnikelo kuNkulunkulu wakho; kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu kuzo zonke izindawo zenu zokuhlala.
Kumelwe nizibalele kusukela ekuseni ngemva kwesabatha, kusukela osukwini enaletha ngalo isithungu somnikelo wokuzuliswa; amasabatha ayisikhombisa kufanele apheleliswe.
Kuze kube ekuseni ngemva kwesabatha lesikhombisa kumelwe nibale izinsuku ezingamashumi amahlanu; futhi kumelwe ninikele ngomnikelo omusha womlilo kuJehova.
Kumelwe nilethe ezindaweni enihlala kuzo izinkwa ezimbili zezingxenye ezimbili eshumini; kumelwe kube yimpuphu ecolekileyo; kumelwe ziphekwe ngemvubelo; bayizithelo zokuqala zeNkosi.

Kumelwe ulungise kanye nesinkwa amawundlu angamaduna aneminyaka eyisikhombisa ubudala angenasici neduna elilodwa nezinqama ezimbili; kuyakuba ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuJehova, kanye nomnikelo wazo wokudla, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwa, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa. Ngomlilo, iphunga elimnandi enkazimulweni yeNkosi.
Kumelwe unikele ngenqama eyodwa njengomnikelo wesono namawundlu angamaduna aneminyaka emibili ubudala njengomnikelo wokubonga.
Umpristi kumelwe akusondeze kanye nesinkwa samazibulo njengomnikelo wokuzuliswa phambi kukaJehova, kanye namawundlu amabili; kuyakuba ngcwele kuJehova ngezompristi.
Kumelwe nimemezele ngalolo suku, ukuze kube umbuthano ongcwele kini; ningasebenzi msebenzi; kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade ezindlini zenu zonke ezizukulwaneni zenu.

Uma nibutha isivuno sezwe lakini, akumelwe nihlanze amagumbi ezwe lakini lapho nivuna, futhi akumelwe nibuthe imvuthuluka esivunweni sakho; kufanele uyishiyele ompofu nomfokazi. UJehova unguNkulunkulu wakho.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Tshono ebantwaneni bakoIsrayeli uthi: Ngenyanga yesikhombisa, ngolokuqala lwenyanga kuzakuba kini isabatha, isikhumbuzo sokubethwa kwamacilongo, umbuthano ongcwele.
Aniyikwenza umsebenzi wokukhonza kulo, kepha ninikele ngomnikelo womlilo kuJehova.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Ngosuku lweshumi lwale nyanga yesikhombisa kumelwe kube usuku lokubuyisana; liyakuba yinhlangano engcwele kini; futhi kumelwe niyihluphe imiphefumulo yenu futhi ninikele ngomnikelo womlilo kuJehova.
Ngalolo suku ningasebenzi msebenzi, ngokuba kulusuku lokubuyisana ukunenzela ukubuyisana phambi kukaJehova uNkulunkulu wenu.
Ngoba loba ngubani ongacindezelwanga ngalolosuku uzaqunywa phakathi kwabantu bakibo.
Futhi wonke umphefumulo owenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi ngalolo suku, lowo mphefumulo ngiyowuqothula phakathi kwabantu bawo.
Aniyikwenza msebenzi; kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu kuzo zonke izindawo zenu zokuhlala.
Kumelwe kube isabatha lokuphumula kini, futhi kumelwe nicindezele imiphefumulo yenu; ngosuku lwesishiyagalolunye lwenyanga, kusihlwa, kusukela kusihlwa kuze kube kusihlwa, uzogcina isabatha lakho.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Tshono ebantwaneni bakoIsrayeli uthi: Ngosuku lwetshumi lanhlanu lwaleyo nyanga yesikhombisa umkhosi wamadokodo uzakuba yizinsuku eziyisikhombisa eNkosini.
Ngosuku lokuqala kuyakuba khona umbuthano ongcwele; ningasebenzi msebenzi kuyo.

Izinsuku eziyisikhombisa niyakunikela ngomnikelo womlilo kuJehova; ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili kuyakuba ngumhlangano ongcwele kini; futhi kumelwe ninikele ngomnikelo womlilo kuJehova. Yisikhathi samaholide; ningenzi msebenzi wakukhonza kulo.

Le yimikhosi kaJehova eniyakuyimemezela ibe yimibuthano engcwele ukuba nilethe umnikelo womlilo kuJehova, umnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wempuphu, nomnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokuphuzwayo, konke ngosuku lwawo.
Ngaphandle kwamasabatha eNkosi, langaphandle kwezipho zenu, langaphandle kwezithembiso zenu zonke, langaphandle kweminikelo yenu yonke yesihle eninikela ngayo eNkosini.
“ ‘Ngosuku lweshumi nanhlanu lwenyanga yesikhombisa, lapho nibutha izithelo zezwe, niyakugcina umkhosi wokudumisa uJehova izinsuku eziyisikhombisa;

Ngosuku lokuqala kumelwe nizithathele amagatsha emithi emihle, amagatsha esundu namagatsha ezihlahla eziminyene nemizaneni emfuleni; nijabule phambi kukaJehova uNkulunkulu wenu izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Kumelwe niwugcine izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngonyaka umkhosi wokudumisa uJehova. Kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu; ngenyanga yesikhombisa liwugubhe.
Izinsuku eziyisikhombisa niyohlala ezindlini; bonke abazelwe kwa-Israyeli bayakuhlala emadokodweni;
ukuze izizukulwane zenu zazi ukuthi ngabahlalisa abantwana bakoIsrayeli emadumbeni ekubakhupheni kwami elizweni leGibhithe; nginguJehova uNkulunkulu wenu.
UMose wabazisa abantwana bakwa-Israyeli imikhosi kaJehova.
